patterns.note: A responsive two-column grid is used for project display, adapting to available space, with generous gutters and card padding.
The main content area is horizontally centered with wide, consistent side margins, creating a focused presentation.
Section titles and tags use a smaller, uppercase, light grey sans-serif font for clear categorization without visual dominance.
A high-contrast monochrome palette of off-white, white, and various shades of dark grey/black is used, with minimal accent colors reserved for embedded images.
A compact profile bubble with the user's name and avatar sticks to the top of the viewport after an initial larger profile card scrolls out of view.
A small, informative 'availability' badge fades in and sticks to the bottom-left corner of the viewport after the initial scroll.

technique_notes: To rebuild the sticky header, the initial profile card would scroll normally, while a smaller, pre-styled profile bubble (initially hidden or off-screen) would be revealed and fixed to the top of the viewport once the scroll position passes a certain threshold.

The floating availability badge would be initially hidden and then revealed with a subtle fade-in animation, fixed to the bottom-left of the viewport, once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Project cards are presented in a flexible grid layout, using a consistent white background and subtle rounded corners, with content (image, text, tags) contained within.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are moderately larger and bolder than body text, with smaller, uppercase labels used for section titles and tags.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are consistently applied to cards, buttons, and the sticky profile bubble, giving a soft, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy density, with generous padding within cards and ample vertical spacing between major sections and grid items.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its 'operating system' like cleanliness and the dynamic sticky header that transforms from a larger profile card into a compact, persistent bubble on scroll. This creates a highly personalized and functional navigation element.
